recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty portrait of a central figure with an intense expression, set within a dark, rocky urban environment. The composition features a vertical text block on the left and a central graffiti-style logo, utilizing a limited palette of muted earth tones punctuated by vibrant red and blue.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's dynamic pose creates a diagonal tension against the vertical left-side text.
The rough texture of the rock background mirrors the distressed quality of the typography.
The blue graffiti logo acts as a focal point, contrasting against the warm skin tones and dark background.
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the left margin
High-contrast, low-key lighting with deep shadows
Distressed, jagged edges on all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, slightly crouched, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the blue graffiti-style logo in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the intense facial expression, moves down the body to the reaching hand, then jumps to the vertical red text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy and dark, concentrated in the upper right and lower left corners to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and earthy browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and highlights on the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red for vertical text and electric blue for the central logo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the primary color accents which pop against the desaturated environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to one warm accent and one cool accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif for vertical text; jagged, irregular script for central logo.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical text: Extra-bold, condensed, blocky with distressed edges.
Central logo: Sharp, thorn-like extensions, varying stroke weights, and dripping or splattered effects.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the central logo should interlock and overlap with aggressive, pointed terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, vertical block type and chaotic, organic hand-lettering.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the left text
Aggressive, sharp nature of the central logo

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed, heavy block feel for the vertical text.
Captures the jagged, aggressive energy of the central logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast photo of a person with long dreadlocks in an intense, shouting pose, wearing textured urban clothing, set inside a dark, rocky cavern or alleyway. Use low-key lighting with deep shadows and a grainy film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical column of bold, distressed red block text along the left edge. Overlay a jagged, electric-blue graffiti-style logo in the center-right, ensuring it slightly overlaps the subject's clothing.

verificationChecks: Is the left-side text oriented vertically?
Does the central logo have sharp, aggressive terminals?
Is the overall image texture grainy and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the red and blue accents
Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or trademarked logos
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text does not touch the subject.
Check that the blue logo is legible as a graphic shape even if the letters are abstract.
Verify that the film grain is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the color palette remains restricted to the specified tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-intensity urban portrait with a dual-typographic system: one rigid/vertical and one chaotic/central, unified by a heavy grit texture and a primary-color-on-dark-neutral palette.
